hero.title: MBS in Italy for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: MBS in Italy for Indian students can be an option for students who want to develop advanced knowledge of business, management, finance, marketing and international trade. In Italy there is a range of postgraduate business and management programs offered at universities and business schools. You can study European markets, entrepreneurship, innovation and international business practices.

highlights.eligibility: Recognised academic qualification + English / Italian proficiency

overview: MBS in Italy for Indian students can be an option for students who want to develop advanced knowledge of business, management, finance, marketing and international trade. In Italy there is a range of postgraduate business and management programs offered at universities and business schools. You can study European markets, entrepreneurship, innovation and international business practices.

One important point for applicants is that Master of Business Studies (MBS) is not a standard degree title used by every Italian university. Similar programs may be offered as a Master's Degree in Management , International Business, Business Administration or a university level post graduate master's program. Students should confirm the official title of the qualification, its length, entry requirements and recognition status before applying.

The right program for an Indian student depends on their academic background, career goals, tuition budget, preferred language of teaching and whether they want to work in Italy, India or another international market.
Studying a postgraduate program in Business or Management in Italy can open up professional and academic opportunities for international students.
International business exposure: European markets, international trade, global strategy and cross cultural management.
Recognized universities: Find business and management programs from established Italian higher education institutions.
English-taught options: Several Italian institutions offer postgraduate programs in English, but the availability of languages varies from course to course.
Practical learning: Depending on the program, students may work on case studies, group projects, company assignments and business research.
Possible specializations: Study areas such as finance, marketing, entrepreneurship, human resource management and international business.
Industry connections: Some schools have networking events, career services, internships, or projects with companies.
European career exposure: Studying in Italy can assist students in comprehending European business practices and look for possible employment opportunities after graduation.
Cultural experience: Students will experience the academic environment and business sectors in Italy, including manufacturing, fashion, luxury goods, tourism and technology.
Before selecting a course, students should compare the curriculum, language of teaching, links with industry, tuition fees and qualification given by each institution.

sections.title: Who can study an MBS in Italy?

items: In Italy, the criteria of eligibility to an MBS-related program depend on whether the course is a second-cycle academic degree or a professional postgraduate master's program.
Some examples of eligibility criteria may include:
Bachelor's degree: Normally a recognized undergraduate qualification from a recognized institution.
Academic performance Students must fulfill the minimum academic requirements of the program.
Educational background: Some management programs are open to graduates from any discipline, while others expect you to have already studied business, economics or a related field.
English language proficiency: English-taught courses may require IELTS, TOEFL or other accepted qualification. The university decides what the exemptions are.
Entrance assessment: Some programs may require an aptitude test, interview or assessment of academic and work experience.
Additional requirements: Some professional programs may require a motivation letter, relevant work experience or other evidence.

For example, the University of Bologna's professional Master's in International Management has its own degree, language and selection criteria. These requirements should not be automatically applied to other programs.
Students are advised to check the official eligibility criteria before applying.
5. Requirements for Enrollment in MBS in Italy

Admission process differs from one Italian University to another. Applications are usually assessed on the basis of prior education, academic performance, language skills and suitability for the chosen program.
Typical admission requirements include:
A recognized bachelor's degree.
Academic certificates and transcripts.
Statement of purpose / letter of motivation.
Current CV or resume.
If required, English language proficiency test scores.
Letters of recommendation, if required.
Entrance examination or interview, if applicable.
Payment receipt for application fee (if applicable).

Some programs may require additional documentation or an assessment of the applicant's previous academic subjects. The admission process for professional postgraduate programs may be different from the admission process for two-year academic masters programs.
Applicants should also make sure that their qualification meets the entry requirements of the institution and whether any documents need to be translated or authenticated.

sections.title: Cost of pursuing MBS in Italy

items: The cost of studying business and management in Italy varies depending on the institution, the type of qualification, the length of the program and the fee structure.
The indicative tuition-planning ranges below do not represent the universal MBS fees or confirmed quotes for each university.

For comparison, the University of Bologna has listed tuition for its professional Master's in International Management at €9,500 for 2026-27 and for its professional Master's in Business Management at €13,800. This is not a general MBS price list, these are program specific fees.
The INR equivalents are based on an indicative exchange rate of €1 = INR 108.60. Current exchange rates and bank charges may be applied.
Students should set aside separate funds for additional costs such as:
Application fees and entrance-test fees.
Cost of visas and residence permits.
Health insurance and mandatory administrative costs.
Books, learning materials and program specific costs.
Accommodation, food, transport and other personal living costs.

You may be eligible for scholarships, fee reductions or installment plans on select programs. The availability of the program varies by institution, eligibility requirements, funding, and application deadlines.
Indian students can generally apply for an MBS-related course in Italy by following the steps below.
Choose a program: Look for a Master's in Management, International Business, Business Administration or a professional postgraduate master's qualification.
Check the degree title: Check whether the qualification is a second-cycle academic degree or a professional master's program at university level.
Check eligibility : Check academic qualifications, language requirements, selection criteria and relevant experience requirements.
Prepare documents: Gather your transcripts, degree certificates, CV, motivation letter, language test results and any other required documents.
Apply Online Submit your application via the university's official portal and attend any required assessments or interviews.
Get the admission decision: Check the admission offer, fee schedule, deadlines and any conditions attached to admission.

Full pre-enrolment: carry out the Italian pre-enrolment procedure as provided for by the regulations, via Universitaly. The university will tell you what documents you need to submit and what steps to take.
Apply for student visa: Follow most recent requirements issued by relevant Italian consular authority, including financial evidence, accommodation details and other applicable documents.
Full enrollment: Once you have met the university & visa requirements, complete your final registration by following the instructions provided by the institution.
Application deadlines vary between universities and programs. Students should start early enough to prepare the documents, complete the selection procedures and meet the visa timelines.
When selecting an MBS related course in Italy it is important to know what type of qualification will be awarded.

Italian institutions can offer academic second-cycle qualifications (e.g. the Laurea Magistrale) or professional postgraduate qualifications (known as Master universitario). These qualifications are different in structure and should not be automatically equated.
Students should check before they enroll:
The official title of the qualification.
The institutional and programmatic status.
The level, length & credits.
whether the program is appropriate for further academic study.
Whether the qualification is recognized by employers in the intended industry.
Whether the qualification is recognized in India or any other country for the further education or for the professional recognition.

The use of the title Master in the title of a program does not itself establish that it is equivalent to every other master's degree. Students returning to India should check the relevant recognition requirements for their chosen academic or professional pathway.

faq.question: Can Indian students study MBS in Italy?
faq.answer: Yes. Indian students can apply to suitable postgraduate business and management programs in Italy if they meet the academic, language and other programme-specific admission requirements.

faq.question: How long will MBS be in Italy?
faq.answer: The qualification determines how long you do it. Many academic second-cycle programs are two years in length, whereas some professional university master programs are about one year in length.

faq.question: What is the cost of studying MBS in Italy?
faq.answer: Tuition fees differ according to university and program. To give an idea of costs, selected professional programs can cost around €9,000-€15,000 and other business and management programs can cost considerably more. Always check the current fee of the institution.

faq.question: Do I need IELTS for MBS in Italy?
faq.answer: IELTS is not a compulsory requirement for each and every program. Some institutions will accept other English language qualifications, or there may be exemptions under certain circumstances. Applicants should check the language requirements of the course they have chosen.

faq.question: Can I Work in Italy After an MBS?
faq.answer: Graduates may look for jobs, subject to compliance with the relevant immigration and work authorization rules. Career outcomes will depend on the qualification, professional skills, language proficiency, employer requirements and job availability.
